title: Ghost Adventures: House Calls
description:
S03 E03 — Fremont Home Invasion
Zak's team braces for a chaotic spiritual storm when they are called to Ohio; they help a couple reclaim their historic dream home from a horde of aggressive ghosts; could the capture of a childlike form reveal the culprit?

title: The Bassquatch Hunter: Fish Out of Water
description:
S04 E12 — America's Thanksgiving Parade vs. Kayak Fishing
Mike is on the scene with AmeriGas Propane, where he learns all about practicing proper propane safety. But what if something goes wrong?

title: Auction Kings
description:
S03 E04 — Mountain Man Slot Machine; Wild West BMW Motorcycle
A "Star Trek: Generations" uniform; a vintage Mountain Man slot machine; a Wild West-themed BMW motorcycle with a sidecar.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
The Car-tell
Every year, CBP officers process thousands of vehicles. Some look ordinary, and others are built to deceive -- because at the border, four wheels and an engine could be a cover for contraband.

title: Major League Fishing
description:
Stage Six Championship Round: Grand Lake O' the Cherokees
The Stage Six Championship Round of Major League Fishing's Bass Pro Tour from Early, TX, where the final 10 anglers compete for the trophy and a top prize of $125,000.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E18 — Runaway Train
As 25-foot breakers pound the fleet, critical systems fail at the worst possible time; Sig's engine runs wild, Jake loses power, John's crane cracks and Rick must replace a lackluster deckhand, opening the door for the return of a favorite greenhorn.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E05 — Spirits of 1776
As America marks its 250th birthday, reports of Revolutionary War ghosts draw Phil, Heather and Jack Osbourne to historic battlefields in Pennsylvania. Their investigation uncovers unsettling encounters at some of the nation's most storied sites.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E04 — Ghosts of Guam
Guam's brutal wartime past is said to have left more than scars upon its shores; after reports of hostile spirits and unexplained encounters, Phil and Heather venture from haunted battlefields into the island's remote jungle in search of answers.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E03 — Curse of the Skinwalkers
A series of terrifying encounters in the Navajo Nation has renewed fears of the legendary Skinwalker. With the help of a local expert, Phil and Heather journey deep into a cursed valley and investigate a cave that few dare to enter.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E01 — Robin Hood's Ghosts
The team travels to Nottingham, home to the legend of Robin Hood; as they investigate whether centuries of bloodshed have left a paranormal legacy of terror, their search leads them to Sherwood Forest, and a seeming encounter with the restless dead.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E02 — Secrets of Sherwood Forest
Phil and Heather continue their investigation into the dark legend of Robin Hood in Nottingham, England; while exploring reports of hostile ghosts in a medieval prison and sinister pagan rituals in Sherwood Forest, the team uncovers shocking answers.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E01 — The Tesla Terrorizer
A woman is caught on camera defecating on a car; a man makes off with a tow truck, wreaking havoc through the streets of New York City.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E02 — The Kilted Keisterer?
Tizzy identifies a brazen shopper who places merchandise under his kilt; an angry golfer tees off on bystanders; a man has an ice cream truck meltdown; a woman claims a public beach as her own private yard.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E05 — The Nightmare Neighbor
Tizzy sparks an internet movement to end a woman's racially charged harassment of her neighbors; a parking lot guard is targeted by a driver; a disgruntled customer wrecks a GameStop.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E06 — The Bumper Sticker Brawl
Tizzy investigates an assault triggered by a bumper sticker; a judge dishes out justice for an attack on a fast food worker, and a couple of road rage incidents have Tizzy fired up.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E08 — Beverly Hills Banger
Tizzy investigates a frightening confrontation between a man and a pair of Beverly Hills reality show stars; a woman allegedly pepper sprays another driver for going too slowly, and a delivery person busts up a Taco Bell.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E04 — The Mystery Pistol Packer
Tizzy tries to identify a man filmed pulling a gun on skateboarders; a road rager who reportedly used his coffee cup as a weapon is identified by his tattoos; a confrontation over a car charger leaves a woman seeking Tizzy's help.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E07 — Road Rage on the Underage
Tizzy investigates a driver who violently assaults a teenage boy riding a bike; a customer catches a brazen shoplifter, and a woman nearly runs over her boyfriend at a gas station.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E03 — The Tip Jar Bandit
Tizzy investigates complaints of a serial tip jar thief; a woman goes on a tirade in a parking lot; the police sort out a cyclist's accusations against a motorist.

description:
S20 E01 — King Crab Derby
King Crab's return ignites a derby-style race; after losing the Saga, Jake joins Sig as co-captain; a serious hip injury tests Sophia; fire on the Wizard traps Keith's deckhand below deck; Bill faces his hardest test yet.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E10 — Utah County Jail
In Utah County, Sheriff Mike Smith runs a behavior-based jail, where good conduct earns inmates greater privileges and access to programs built to break the cycle of recidivism.

title: Orange County Choppers Original
description:
S01 E06 — My Valentine
For the season finale, Paul Teutul Sr. builds a Valentine's Day bike for the love of his life, Joannie Kay.

title: Jeff Dunham's the Cars That Drove Us
description:
S01 E03 — Trans Am
The Pontiac Trans Am isn't just part of the muscle car movement, it's a statement and a complete package on the track or on the streets; a star of "Smokey and the Bandit" and "Knight Rider," the Trans Am pushes muscle cars to the limit.

title: RV There Yet?
description:
S05 E11 — Season Five Finale
Patrice and Kevin McCabe reminisce about their America250 season, and go through all of the outtakes and bloopers — including the RV There Yet? music video.

title: Homestead Rescue
description:
S12 E13 — Raney Returns: Big Sky, Bigger Problems
Marty responds to a new call for help from the Welchels, who struggle to manage their 40-acre homestead after their ranch hand left; he gives them a new, life-changing masterclass on homestead consolidation.

title: Homestead Rescue
description:
S12 E05 — Heartland Heartache
Farmsteaders are on the verge of losing the legacy of their late father; the Raneys must quickly give them an off-grid masterclass and help them complete one of the unique rescues.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S16 E04 — A Shart at Redemption
After poisoning the water in her fan 14-day challenge, survivalist Ashley seeks redemption in Tobago with a new partner, but making it to 21 days in a rain-sodden jungle will push them beyond their limits.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S17 E06 — This is Harder Than it Looks
A photographer and an engineer believe they have what it takes to survive 14 days in Limpopo, South Africa; after 10 days without food, these fans question their ability to make it to the end.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S15 E05 — Kalahari Cold Front
Jaclin, a paralegal, and Michael, a fishing boat captain, take on 21 days in the mighty Kalahari Desert; they soon are hit with an unexpected cold front and aggressive lions and rhinos threatening their shelter.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S02 E05 — Nightmare Before Christmas
During Christmas in 2023, severe storms unleashed an unseasonal tornado outbreak across Tennessee; as dozens of eyewitnesses capture the unbelievable, destructive power of nature, a twister strikes an electrical substation, triggering an explosion.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E04 — Houston Hurricane Hell
When Hurricane Harvey hit Texas with 130 mph winds and record-breaking rain, cameras captured catastrophic flooding as entire neighborhoods vanished, forcing civilians to risk their own lives to save others.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E07 — Stranded in St. Louis
In May 2025, eyewitnesses capture scenes of destruction as a mile-wide tornado tears through the city of St. Louis; when warning sirens fail, residents are caught off guard while visitors panic 630 feet above the ground inside the Gateway Arch.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E11 — Father's Day Fury
A rogue storm in the Texas Panhandle ignites a monster outbreak, unleashing over 80 tornadoes across 14 states; witnesses scramble for safety as a deadly EF3 cuts power and silences tornado sirens.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E12 — The 40-State Storm
In January 2026, a monstrous 2,000-mile winter storm unleashes chaos across 40 states. A 100-car pileup traps motorists in Michigan, a freight train smashes a stranded semi, and first responders race to save a driver sinking in a frozen pond.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E05 — The Dakota EF5
Eyewitnesses capture severe weather across the Dakotas as tornadoes tear through neighborhoods and farm structures.

title: Truck Dynasty
description:
S01 E03 — It's a Boat. It's a Truck. It's BoatTruck.
Due to a windfall from a custom project, Joe plans to create the Boat Truck, an amphibious Jeep; with a buyer for the Defender falling through, Pop, Jerry Jr. and Frank are tasked with finding buyers for both the Defender and the Boat Truck.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E02 — Bering Sea Gut Check
As competition heats up on the King Crab grounds, Jake's next move puts him at odds with Capt. Sig. Wild Bill battles heavy seas and side effects; Sophia Bob Nielsen attempts to pop in a deckhand's dislocated hip to avoid a steam back to town.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S02 E03 — Gator Poacher
When wildlife agents find an alligator with a fresh bullet wound to the head, nearby anglers are the prime suspects; an injured hunter must be evacuated by helicopter; agents use drones to track crabbers selling their catch across state lines.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S03 E03 — Guns and Meth
When a child is thrown from a boat and badly injured, wildlife agents are first on the scene; a night hunter faces multiple felony charges when agents make a grave discovery, agents confront a jet ski rider who risks drowning and gets belligerent.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S03 E02 — Stalking Bears
LDWF biologists on a conservation mission get hands-on with black bear cubs, facing a protective mama bear; hunters get caught using a banned method to hunt ducks; wildlife agents stake out after dark for a felon with an illegal gun.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S02 E07 — Blood Don't Lie
Wildlife agents question a hunter with something to hide; a group of youths shooting ducks from a moving boat is caught in the act; frightened hunters accuse a landowner of serial harassment.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S05 E06 — No Secrets Allowed
A new recruit hoping for her first drug seizure strikes it lucky; an unlikely smuggler is caught with nearly $50,000 in cash; officers find a fuel tank that's got more than gas inside it; a bus is searched after a K9 alerts to a strange smell.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E02 — Cocaine Chihuahua
As a man attempts to cross the border, he is flagged as having an outstanding manslaughter warrant; officers discover a secret stash of cocaine hidden inside a tractor-trailer; a woman caught with prescription pills is suspected of drug dealing.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S06 E05 — Under Pressure
When a bus is stopped for a routine search, an X-ray reveals some contents may be under pressure; a U.S. family's pet parakeet is denied entry into Mexico and without special USDA approval, it may not be allowed back into America either.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S01 E11 — Operation Shadow Vial
Officers find a box of syringes filled with a mysterious black liquid; a computer programmer from South Korea raises suspicions when he says he's coming for business meetings, but it sounds like he's planning to work in the US illegally.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S01 E01 — Please Don't Be Cow Poop!
Intel arrives, sending officers searching for two suspected narcotics smugglers flying in from London; agriculture specialists get more than they bargained for when a passenger lands with some illegal and foul-smelling items.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S02 E12 — From Lies to Leads
After two unclaimed cargo packages are opened, experts are called in after officers suspect that they may contain stolen ancient artifacts.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E02 — Leake County Jail
In rural Leake County, Mississippi, a small jail battles a big meth problem; with repeat offenders entering the jail daily, local law enforcement works to break the cycle.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E04 — Caddo Parish Correctional Center
Caddo Parish Correctional Center is struggling with a staffing shortage, the inmates outnumber the deputies by 180 to one; to ensure the safety of both inmates and staff alike, the Emergency Response Team springs into action.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E08 — San Joaquin County Jail
At the crossroads of one of the West Coast's busiest narcotics corridors, Sheriff Patrick Withrow and his deputies confront violent offenders, rival gangs and the ongoing battle to stop contraband from entering California's San Joaquin County Jail.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E05 — San Francisco County Jail
In a city gripped by fentanyl and rising drug arrests, San Francisco's largest jail is on the front lines of addiction; it fights to give inmates a shot at recovery, rehabilitation and a path forward.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
Ferreting Out the Problem
Each year, CBP officers inspect thousands of animals, including family pets and exotic wildlife -- because at the border, the threat may come from a different species. Some look innocent, while others carry hidden dangers.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E11 — Tennessee Dyer County Jail
At Tennessee's Dyer County Jail, overcrowding, contraband and violence strain an understaffed facility, where drugs have been smuggled in by officers and violence among inmates has turned deadly.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E10 — Utah County Jail
In Utah County, Sheriff Mike Smith runs a behavior-based jail, where good conduct earns inmates greater privileges and access to programs built to break the cycle of recidivism.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E03 — Suffolk County Correctional Facility
As an opioid epidemic grips the county, a law-and-order sheriff uses rehabilitation to help inmates break the cycle of addiction while officers work around the clock to maintain safety, security and order inside one of New York's busiest jails.

title: Street Outlaws: Locals Only
description:
S02 E15 — One Local Above Them All
Locals from across the country gather for the finale, where they'll face off to see which track can take the win; then, the final racer confronts small tire legend Boosted GT, even the best have their hands full against Chris Hamilton.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E03 — A Titan Among Men
Jake aims to prove himself on the Titan Explorer after he leaves Sig's boat; Sig and Johnathan race to get ahead of a migrating king crab hoard in an underwater canyon; Rick incurs Keith's wrath when his captain-in-training launches a rogue set.

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S03 E11 — Popcorn Sutton Challenge
Guest Judge Pam Sutton joins Mark, Digger and Tim as three Master Distiller champions face real backwoods elements as they compete to make Popcorn Sutton's legendary outlaw corn whiskey recipe using tools and techniques from the past.

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S03 E13 — Italian Grappa
Mark, Digger, and Tim judge while Tickle brings the history and hilarity as two legal distillers compete with a backwoods outlaw moonshiner to determine who can turn the scraps from wine-making into the best jar of grappa, Italy's original moonshine.

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S08 E06 — Jimmy Red Corn Reborn
Three distillers compete to resurrect a Civil War-era shine made from Jimmy Red Corn, a rare variety once nearly extinct; judged by Tim, Tickle and guest expert Tim Jones, only one will master its flavor and earn a coveted spot on the shelf.

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S08 E01 — Ultimate Vodka Showdown
Legal and outlaw distillers face off with different raw ingredients to craft pot-still vodka; but when Tim, Tickle, and Digger spring a final-round twist.
